crossLink.title: Reasons to invest with Fugro
crossLink.description: Fugro positions itself as a global leader in Geo-data, offering critical insights that support energy, infrastructure and water projects worldwide. The company has transformed into a more resilient, diversified business with improved financial performance and a strong foundation for future growth. It is well placed to benefit from major global trends, including the energy transition, large-scale infrastructure investment and climate adaptation needs. Its value proposition centres on delivering integrated map, model and monitor solutions, using advanced technology and digital tools to improve safety, efficiency and environmental understanding. A highly skilled workforce and flexible, market-agnostic assets strengthen its competitive position. Fugro also emphasises innovation, disciplined capital allocation and a diversified client base, supporting long-term value creation, sustainable growth and consistently delivering reliable operational excellence and attractive shareholder returns for its stakeholders.

content.metaDescription:
For Fugro, 2025 proved to be a challenging year. Rapidly changing energy markets – especially the 
headwinds facing offshore wind projects in several countries – resulted in a marked slowdown in early‑stage site characterisation work.

content.metaTitle: Fugro secures additional survey contracts for Greater Sunrise TLNG and Bayu Undan Pipeline Highway projects in Timor-Leste
content.metaDescription: In addition to the geophysical survey contract announced on 17 July 2026, Fugro has secured two further awards from Timor-Leste’s Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources (MPRM) in support of the Greater Sunrise TLNG development and Bayu-Undan Pipeline Highway projects. The awards comprise a major heavy geotechnical survey and a metocean survey as part of the wider survey campaign for the proposed pipeline routes.
